title: The Fermi-Pasta-Ulam system and the Korteweg-de Vries equation: a low-regularity continuum limit
summary: For the infinite Fermi-Pasta-Ulam (FPU) system, general solutions can be approximated by counter-propagating waves associated with solutions to the Korteweg-de Vries (KdV) equation as the lattice mesh size goes to zero. We show that, by exploiting the conservation of the FPU Hamiltonian, the continuum limit from the FPU system to the KdV equation with $L^2$-level initial data holds in appropriate norms on an arbitrary time interval, thereby answering an open question posed by Hong, Kwak, and Yang (2021).
